settings.intro: Rainforest, surf and a coastline shaped by tides. Discover Gabon’s demanding beach and estuary fishing.

settings.heading: Explore the fishing.
settings.intro: Where rainforest meets ocean, fish the beaches and estuary around Loango National Park for tarpon, threadfin, jacks and other coastal species.

settings.heading: Loango National Park
settings.text: Wild coast and estuary water make Loango a distinctive place to fish and explore.

settings.heading: Tarpon and coastal species
settings.text: Target tarpon, threadfin, jacks, kob and barracuda from the beach and nearby waters.

settings.heading: October to April
settings.text: The legacy expedition lists October through April as the fishing season, with a peak window for large tarpon from mid-November to late January.

settings.heading: Plan your next trip.
settings.text: Tell us your preferred window. Our team will confirm current departures and arrangements.
